narrative: The nave of Holy Trinity from a pew, August light coming green off the river side. Two women in dark gowns stand at the end of the pew, their backs to the frame, one cuff still undone on the nearer wrist. No faces. No children.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: In The nave, from the pew

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the end of the pew, her back to the frame.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood beside her. The undone cuff was on the nearer wrist.

entities.name: Holy Trinity
